segments.name: Consumer finance
segments.description: Provides credit products through financing programs with retailers, merchants, manufacturers and healthcare providers, plus FDIC-insured deposit products via Synchrony Bank.
segments.evidence: We primarily offer private label, Dual Card, co-brand and general purpose credit cards, as well as short- and long-term installment loans, and savings products insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation ("FDIC") through Synchrony Bank (the "Bank").

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay interest and fees on credit card and installment loans, and the company earns retailer share arrangements and interchange from partner programs.
revenueModel.evidence: Those platforms are organized by the types of partners we work with, and are measured on interest and fees on loans, loan receivables, active accounts and other sales metrics.
